ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: AlbA reads your health data (activity, sleep, vitals, nutrition) to show you trends and give you personalised advice. Your data stays on your iPhone.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock AlbA.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AlbA accesses your photos only to import the reports you choose.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: AlbA uses the camera only to photograph your medical reports.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AlbA uses the microphone only while you talk to your coach.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: AlbA transcribes your voice so you can talk to your coach. When possible, transcription happens on your phone.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: AlbA never writes or changes your data in Health: it only reads it to give you personalised advice.
